description: Connectivity Link (Kuadrant + Gateway API + Istio) observability for platform engineers and developers. Post-migration operational dashboard.

targets.expr: count(sum by (destination_workload) (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",destination_workload=~"$gateway"}[5m])) by (le, destination_workload)) > 250) > 0) or vector(0)

topk(20, (sum by (route, destination_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",destination_workload=~"$gateway",response_code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (route, destination_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",destination_workload=~"$gateway"}[5m])) * 100)

title: Connectivity Link — Platform & Developer Observability
